title: SB2523 (112th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, relative to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2022-02-02; own version, official copy via the Internet Archive snapshot 20260514165224 of https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/112/Bill/SB2523.pdf; the last listed version was not archived)
provenance.note: Draft as filed, 2022-02-02; House and Senate twins share the text. Summary says "As introduced"; no amendments are in the text read, and the bill has no passage vote in the file.

operative_text: SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1350(d)): (5) For purposes of this section, "law enforcement officer" also means a person who has been issued an enhanced handgun carry permit pursuant to § 39-17-1351; provided, that the enhanced handgun carry permit is not suspended, revoked, or expired.
